admin_password_file.description: Path to the file that holds the admin password. Allowed below /etc/energy-node/ and /etc/energy-node-dashboard/.

bind_address.description: Network address the dashboard listens on. 0.0.0.0 accepts connections on every network interface.

client_id.title: MQTT client ID

node_device_id.description: ID under which the node itself appears as a device in MQTT and Home Assistant. Must be energy_node.

node_device_name.title: Node display name

sweep_interval_seconds.description: Seconds between two saves of the last known device values to disk, so that they are shown again after a restart. A value set under Settings > General takes precedence.
